description: CER - Small-scale Installations - Small Generation Unit - Wind is a series of datasets listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of the Commonwealth of Australia - Clean Energy Regulator. This dataset presents the footprint of the number of installations of small generation unit (SGU) wind systems and their rated output in kilowatts (kW). The data includes the total over the months from 2001 to 2019. The data is aggregated to Postal Areas (POAs) from the 2016 Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS). Coverage: Australia. The portal lists 17 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Government of the Commonwealth of Australia - Clean Energy Regulator. Its tags are BUILT ENVIRONMENT AND DESIGN, Climate change science, Climate change science not elsewhere classified, Design, EARTH SCIENCES. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
